title: bredemeyera microphylla

This plant is valued for its traditional uses in folk medicine, particularly in South African cultures. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
